subject: math
topicName: Geometry - Lesson 7: Equation from Diameter Endpoints
description: Find the midpoint and radius from diameter endpoints, then write the equation of a circle.
learningObjectives: Identify the center of a circle as the midpoint of a diameter
Use the midpoint formula with two endpoint coordinates
Use distance or half the diameter length to determine the radius
Write a circle equation in center-radius form
Check that both diameter endpoints satisfy the circle equation
prerequisites: Plotting ordered pairs on the Cartesian plane
Recognizing center-radius form of a circle
